name: circufi-platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @circufi/shared && npm run build -w @circufi/backend && npm run build -w @circufi/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @circufi/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/backend && tsc --noEmit -p packages/frontend

description: CircuFi - digital rotating-savings circles (ajo / osusu / esusu) with trust scoring and an AI assistant
